messages:
Alex: FYI — just finished the customer security call with FinNova. Key asks: RBAC mapping for service accounts, proof of KMS envelope usage, and immutable audit logs for 1yr.

Maria: Nice. Can you paste their exact question about RBAC? They asked for e.g. separation of duties?

Alex: "Please confirm that production service accounts cannot create other service accounts and that rotation keys are restricted to ops role." — paraphrased. They want role matrix + example IAM policy.

Jamal: For RBAC we can provide role mapping + sample SCIM assertion. Suggesting we show the policy snippet and an example of tenant-scoped service account vs. platform service account.

Maria: +1. Also they pressed on audit log integrity — chain or append-only proof, ingestion into their SIEM (Splunk) with signed log tokens.

Alex: We said we support audit streaming (Kafka -> SIEM) and can provide HMAC-signed log blocks. Customer asked about tamper evidence; they requested a small PoC of signed batches.

Sean: Quick note: KMS specifics — they want customer-managed key (BYOK) with envelope encryption. We support wrapping-DEK with customer key in KMS (Cloud HSM), can provide key usage logs and attestations.

eng-sec-bot: deploy-notice: evidence-packet-template v1 uploaded to /evidence/packets/fin_nova_2026_03_21

Alex: Action items agreed on call:
- Provide RBAC role matrix + sample IAM/SCIM configs
- Generate signed audit batch PoC and sample logs shipped to Splunk
- Describe KMS envelope flow with key rotation policy and HSM attestations
- Provide vuln triage summary for recent CVE-2026-XXXX that customer asked about

Maria: Who owns each? I'll take RBAC matrix & SCIM examples. Jamal you do audit PoC. Alex you write KMS envelope diagram + rotation doc. Sean to prep CVE triage note.

Jamal: Started PoC: here's a minimal example of signed audit batch
```
{"batch_id":"b-20260321-01","events":[{"ts":1633024800,"event":"auth_grant","svc":"ingest"}],"signature":"MEUCIQD..."}
```
I can export into JSONL and push to their Splunk index test: fnv-audit.

Maria: Good. For RBAC sample, we should include a deny-by-default example and show how platform-admin vs tenant-admin differ.

Alex: Will include KMS callflow snippet:
```
1) Generate DEK (256-bit) on-host
2) Wrap DEK with customer KMS via Encrypt API -> returns wrapped_DEK
3) Store wrapped_DEK with model checkpoint metadata
4) On load: KMS.Decrypt(wrapped_DEK) -> DEK -> decrypt checkpoint
```
Also add key rotation note: rotate master key every 90 days, rewrap DEKs lazily on first access.

Sean: CVE note: tracked as INF-4823; vuln is in third-party tokenizer lib — limited exposure to input pipeline only, not to model weights. Patch available in v2.1.4; mitigation applied to hosted and scheduled rollouts for Dedicated.

Alex: Customer asked about incident playbook: we offered a templated IR runbook capturing detection, containment, & customer notification timeline. They want SLA for notification within 4 hours for high-severity.

Maria: We should confirm legal on 4-hour notification commitment. I'll ping @legal.

Jamal: PoC ready in my branch: github.com/redwood/infra/audit-poc branch finnova-signed

Alex: Next steps: assemble packet and schedule a follow-up demo with FinNova next Tue 09:00 PST. I'll send invite and link recording.

Sean: +1. Add a short slide that shows KMS attestations and SIEM integration.

eng-sec-bot: reminder: evidence-packet due in 72 hours for FinNova.

Maria: Thanks team. I'll start draft and drop it in the evidence bucket. If anyone needs specific log samples or HMAC keys for PoC, DM Jamal.

Alex: Closing thread — will post the assembled JSON packet here when ready.
